title: A Happy New Chapter: I Found Someone Special
excerpt: I’ve met someone wonderful. My mod updates may slow down a little, but I have more reasons than ever to keep creating.
content:
I have some happy personal news to share: I'm no longer single. I've met a wonderful woman, and I'm lucky to call her my girlfriend.

She knows I don't own a home or a car right now, but that doesn't bother her. She told me, “We'll have those things someday.” Those simple words meant a lot to me. They made me feel hopeful about the future we're building together.

I want to spend more time with her and give our relationship the care it deserves, so my Starfield mod updates may not be as frequent for a while.

But I'm not giving up on modding. In fact, I have an even stronger reason to keep going. I'll work hard to create more and better mods, build a better life for us, and work toward the day we can get married and make a home of our own.

To everyone who has downloaded and supported the paid Creations I've released so far: thank you from the bottom of my heart. Your support means more than just numbers. It encourages me to keep creating and helps me take small steps toward that future.

Thank you for your understanding and for being part of this journey. Releases may come a little more slowly, but I'll continue putting my heart into every one.

zh-CN.title: 生活的新篇章：我脱单了
zh-CN.excerpt: 最近遇见了一位很好的女朋友。Mod 更新可能会慢一些，但我也有了更坚定的创作动力。
zh-CN.content:
最近想和大家分享一个开心的消息：我脱单了，遇见了一位很好的女朋友。

她知道我现在还没有房子，也没有车，但她并不在意。她对我说：“以后都会有的。”这句简单的话让我很感动，也让我对我们的未来多了一份期待。

接下来，我想多花一些时间陪伴她，认真经营这段感情。所以，最近《星空》Mod 的更新可能不会像以前那么频繁了。

不过，我并没有打算停下创作。恰恰相反，我现在有了更坚定的目标：努力做出更多、更好的 Mod，一步一步把生活过得更好，为将来能和她结婚、拥有属于我们的小家而努力。

最后，我想特别感谢每一位下载和支持我目前已上架付费 Creations 的玩家。你们的支持对我来说不仅仅是数字，更是对我作品的认可，也给了我继续创作、朝着未来努力的动力。

谢谢大家一直以来的理解和陪伴。也许更新会慢一点，但我会继续用心做好每一件作品。

title: Becoming a Bethesda Verified Creator — And a Note About AI
excerpt: I’m incredibly excited to have been accepted into Bethesda’s Verified Creator Program, and I also want to be transparent about how I use AI in my work.
content:
I’m incredibly excited to share that I have been accepted into Bethesda’s Verified Creator Program.

For me, this is a very meaningful milestone. I started making Starfield mods because I enjoyed creating things, experimenting with ideas and sharing them with other players. Being recognized by Bethesda gives me even more motivation to keep learning and to make better work in the future.

At the same time, I have also seen the comments and criticism about AI being used in some of my work, so I want to be transparent about it.

Yes, some of my free mods have used AI-assisted content during the creative process. AI has helped me work more efficiently, explore ideas faster and turn more of those ideas into mods that I can share with the community for free. I understand that people have different opinions about this, and I respect that discussion.

But I also want to make one thing very clear.

My paid Creations on Bethesda Creations are made by hand. I will not use AI-generated content in paid CC releases. The artwork, textures and other content for those paid projects will be created manually, and I take that commitment seriously.

Free projects may continue to be a place where I experiment with new tools and workflows. Paid Creations are different, and I want players to feel confident about what they are supporting.

Thank you to everyone who has downloaded my mods, left feedback, encouraged me, criticized me fairly, or simply spent time playing something I made.

Becoming a Verified Creator feels like the beginning of a new chapter, and I’m very excited to see where it goes.

zh-CN.title: 成为 Bethesda 认证创作者，以及关于 AI 的一些说明
zh-CN.excerpt: 非常高兴加入 Bethesda 认证创作者计划，也想坦诚说明我在创作中如何使用 AI。
zh-CN.content:
我非常激动地告诉大家：我正式通过了 Bethesda 的 Verified Creator Program（认证创作者计划）。

对我而言，这是一个意义重大的里程碑。最初制作《星空》Mod，只是因为我喜欢创造、尝试新想法，并把作品分享给其他玩家。能够得到 Bethesda 的认可，让我更有动力继续学习，在未来做出更好的作品。

与此同时，我也看到了一些关于我在作品中使用 AI 的评论和批评，因此想在这里坦诚地说明。

确实，我的部分免费 Mod 在创作过程中使用过 AI 辅助内容。AI 帮助我提高效率、更快地探索创意，让更多想法得以实现，并免费分享给社区。我理解大家对此有不同看法，也尊重这些讨论。

但有一点，我想明确说明。

我在 Bethesda Creations 上发布的付费 Creations 均由我手工制作。付费 CC 作品不会使用 AI 生成内容。这些付费项目的美术、贴图及其他内容都将由我亲手完成，我会认真履行这一承诺。

免费项目或许仍会是我尝试新工具、新工作流程的空间。但付费 Creations 不一样，我希望玩家能够放心支持我的作品。

感谢所有下载过我的 Mod、提出反馈、鼓励我、给予公正批评，或者只是花时间体验过我作品的玩家。

成为认证创作者就像开启了一个新篇章，我非常期待接下来的旅程。

title: Cassilia Personal Log-03: Project Chimera
excerpt: A recovered personal log from Cassilia describing Ryujin's secret Project Chimera, the failed combat morph serum trials, and the first warform prototypes she refined.
content:
Ryujin called it a research program.

That was the first lie.

In the sealed floors beneath their clean glass towers, behind doors that did not exist on any public map, they were building something far beyond combat stimulants. Not a better soldier. Not a faster operative. Not another disposable chem for some desperate mercenary.

They were trying to rewrite the body itself.

Project Chimera.

A serum designed to force the human form into another combat species for a limited duration. Bone structure. Muscle response. Nerve priority. Instinctive attack behavior. All of it compressed into a controlled transformation window.

Sixty seconds of borrowed evolution.

That was the theory.

The reality was less elegant.

Most test subjects did not survive the first transition. Some transformed halfway and never came back. Some came back with minds that no longer recognized their own bodies. A few lived long enough to become useful data, which, in Ryujin language, meant they were allowed to die after the numbers were recorded.

I was assigned to investigate an internal breach.

Another lie.

They did not send me there to uncover the truth. They sent me there to clean up whatever had escaped it.

I found the bodies first.

Then the cages.

Then the logs.

Then the serum.

Ryujin's scientists believed the failure was in the formula. They were wrong. The failure was in the assumption that an ordinary human body could endure being torn apart and rebuilt while still pretending to be human.

Mine could.

Starborn physiology has certain advantages. Regeneration. Adaptation. Resistance to cellular collapse. A body that has already passed through the impossible tends to be less impressed by corporate science.

The first injection should have killed me.

Instead, it listened.

For sixty seconds, I became something Ryujin had never managed to control. My hands were no longer hands. My reflexes were no longer human. Every movement came with a new instinct, sharp and immediate, like a weapon remembering what it was made for.

When the effect faded, I was still standing.

That frightened them more than the dead subjects ever did.

So I took their research.

Not because they deserved to lose it.

Because they deserved never to finish it.

The original serums were crude, violent, and wasteful. Useful only if you considered human lives a disposable testing material. I refined them. Stabilized the transition window. Reduced rejection. Separated the combat forms into distinct warform profiles.

Automaton.

Beast.

Void.

Titan.

Ryujin built a door and filled the room behind it with corpses.

I learned how to walk through it.

They wanted a weapon they could own.

They made the mistake of showing it to me.

zh-CN.title: Cassilia 私人日志-03：奇美拉计划
zh-CN.excerpt: 一份重见天日的 Cassilia 私人日志，讲述龙神工业的秘密“奇美拉计划”、失败的战斗变形血清试验，以及她亲手改良的第一批战斗形态原型。
zh-CN.content:
龙神工业称它为一项研究计划。

这是第一个谎言。

在那些洁净玻璃高楼之下的封闭楼层里，在任何公开地图上都不存在的门后，他们研发的东西远远超出了战斗兴奋剂的范畴。不是更优秀的士兵。不是更敏捷的特工。也不是给某个走投无路的佣兵使用的廉价药剂。

他们想要重写人体本身。

奇美拉计划。

一种能在有限时间内强行将人体转变为另一种战斗生物的血清。骨骼结构、肌肉反应、神经优先级、本能攻击行为……所有改变都必须挤进一个受控的变形时间窗口。

借来的六十秒进化。

理论上如此。

现实却没那么优雅。

大多数受试者没能熬过第一次转变。有些人的变形只进行到一半，就再也没能恢复；有些人虽然变了回来，意识却已无法认出自己的身体。还有少数人活得足够久，成为了“有价值的数据”——用龙神工业的话来说，就是记录完数据后，他们才被允许死去。

我接到的任务，是调查一次内部安全事件。

又一个谎言。

他们派我去那里，不是为了查明真相，而是为了清理从真相里逃出来的东西。

我最先发现的是尸体。

然后是牢笼。

然后是实验记录。

最后是血清。

龙神工业的科学家以为失败出在配方上。他们错了。真正失败的，是他们竟然相信普通人的身体能够承受被撕碎、重组的过程，之后还能若无其事地继续做人。

而我的身体可以。

星裔的生理结构有一些优势：再生、适应、抵抗细胞崩解。一个已经穿越过不可能之事的身体，很难再被企业的科学实验吓倒。

第一针本该杀死我。

可它却听从了我。

在那六十秒里，我变成了某种龙神工业从未真正控制过的存在。我的双手不再是手，我的反射也不再属于人类。每个动作都伴随着新的本能，锋利、直接，仿佛一件武器突然想起了自己为何而生。

药效消退时，我依然站在那里。

这比所有死去的受试者都更令他们恐惧。

于是，我带走了他们的研究成果。

不是因为他们活该失去它。

而是因为他们根本不配完成它。

最初的血清粗糙、狂暴而且浪费。只有把人命当作一次性实验材料，才会觉得它们有用。我改良了这些血清，稳定了变形时间窗口，降低了排异反应，并把不同的战斗形态分离成独立的形态档案。

机械体（Automaton）。

野兽（Beast）。

虚空（Void）。

泰坦（Titan）。

龙神工业建了一扇门，又用尸体填满门后的房间。

而我学会了穿过那扇门。

他们想要一件可以据为己有的武器。

他们最大的错误，就是把它展示给了我。

title: Cassilia Personal Log-02: A Gift From Another Wasteland
excerpt: A recovered personal log from Cassilia describing a strange Unity jump, a ruined Old Earth, and two gifts from a survivor she once helped.
content:
I have crossed the Unity more times than I can clearly remember.

Most worlds begin to feel familiar after the first few moments.

Different faces.
Different wars.
Different names carved into the same old pain.

But once, the Unity sent me somewhere wrong.

Not wrong as in hostile.
Not wrong as in broken.

Wrong as in impossible.

There were no shining cities of the Settled Systems. No New Atlantis, no Akila, no Neon lights drowning the dark. The world beneath my feet was Old Earth, or something wearing Old Earth's bones.

The sky was sick.
The wind tasted like ash.
Every ruin looked as if it had been waiting for two hundred years for someone to admit that the world had ended.

I had seen dead worlds before.

This one still screamed.

That was where I met the survivor.

I never learned whether fate had chosen him, cursed him, or simply refused to let him die. He carried grief like a weapon and hope like a wound. He was searching for his son.

At first, I thought it was foolish.

One person, wandering through a dead world, chasing a child who might already be lost to time, violence, or something worse.

Then I remembered how many impossible things I had chased.

So I helped him.

We crossed poisoned roads, broken towns, old military ruins and places where science had survived long after mercy disappeared. The people of that world had learned to live among rust, radiation and ghosts. Some were kind. Some were monsters. Most were simply tired.

The survivor never stopped searching.

Not when the trail went cold.
Not when the truth became cruel.
Not when the world gave him every reason to stop.

In the end, he found his son.

I will not write what happened after that.

Some endings do not belong in another person's log.

Before I left, the survivor gave me two things.

The first was a wrist computer from a sealed underground shelter. Heavy, outdated, stubborn and strangely beautiful. Its screen flickered, its casing was scratched, and its interface looked like something built by engineers who believed the future could still be organized with buttons, dials and optimism.

He called it a Pip-Boy.

The second was a blue and yellow vault suit.

At first, I almost laughed.

It was simple. Too simple. A relic from a world that had tried to survive underground while the sky burned above it.

But when I held it, I understood.

It was not just clothing.
It was a promise.

A promise that someone, somewhere, had once believed there would be a tomorrow worth dressing for.

I kept both.

Of course, I could not leave them as they were.

The Pip-Boy was not built for Starborn interference, grav-drive distortion, modern weapons telemetry or the strange habits of the Settled Systems. The vault suit was durable, but not enough for vacuum exposure, hostile atmospheres or the kind of trouble that usually finds me before I find it.

So I began modifying them.

New seals.
New lining.
Better field protection.
A cleaner interface.
A frame that could survive more than nostalgia.

I do not know when the work will be finished.

Part of me wants to keep them.

Part of me knows they were never meant to stay locked away.

One day, perhaps, someone else will wear them.

Someone who understands that even in a dead world, people still search, still fight, still carry hope through the ruins.

The survivor gave me more than a suit and a machine.

He reminded me that some worlds end loudly.

And some people keep walking anyway.

zh-CN.title: Cassilia 私人日志-02：来自另一片废土的礼物
zh-CN.excerpt: 一份 Cassilia 遗留的私人日志：一次奇异的归一之旅、一片破败的旧地球，以及她从曾经帮助过的一位幸存者那里收到的两件礼物。
zh-CN.content:
我穿越归一（Unity）的次数，已经多到自己都记不清了。

大多数世界，在最初的片刻之后便开始变得似曾相识。

不同的面孔。

不同的战争。

不同的名字，被刻进同一种古老的伤痛里。

但有一次，归一把我送到了一个不对劲的地方。

并不是因为那里充满敌意。

也不是因为那里已经破碎。

而是因为那里根本不该存在。

没有定居星系那些光彩夺目的城市。没有新亚特兰蒂斯，没有阿基拉城，也没有驱散黑暗的霓虹灯。脚下的世界是旧地球，或者说，是某个披着旧地球残骸的东西。

天空病了。

风里带着灰烬的味道。

每一处废墟都像已经等待了两百年，只等有人承认这个世界早已终结。

我见过死去的世界。

但这个世界仍在尖叫。

我就是在那里遇见了那位幸存者。

我始终不知道，命运究竟选中了他、诅咒了他，还是仅仅不肯让他死去。他把悲伤当作武器，把希望当作伤口。他正在寻找自己的儿子。

起初，我觉得那很愚蠢。

一个人游荡在死去的世界里，追寻一个可能早已迷失在时间、暴力或更可怕事物之中的孩子。

然后我想起，自己又曾追逐过多少不可能之事。

所以我帮助了他。

我们走过被污染的道路、破败的城镇、旧军方遗迹，还有那些在仁慈消失后依然存活着的科学实验设施。那个世界的人们已经学会与锈蚀、辐射和幽灵共同生活。有些人善良，有些人如同怪物，而大多数人只是疲惫不堪。

那位幸存者从未停止寻找。

即使线索中断。

即使真相残酷。

即使整个世界都在告诉他该放弃了。

最终，他找到了自己的儿子。

至于之后发生了什么，我不会写在这里。

有些结局，不属于另一个人的日志。

离开之前，他送给了我两件东西。

第一件是一台来自密封地下避难所的腕式计算机。沉重、过时、固执，却有种奇异的美感。屏幕闪烁，外壳布满划痕，界面仿佛出自一群仍坚信未来可以靠按钮、旋钮和乐观精神来管理的工程师之手。

他称它为 Pip-Boy（哔哔小子）。

第二件是一套蓝黄相间的避难所制服。

起初，我差点笑了出来。

它太简单了，简单得过分。来自一个曾试图在天空燃烧时躲入地下求生的世界。

但当我把它握在手里时，我明白了。

它不只是一件衣服。

它是一个承诺。

一个承诺：曾经，在某个地方，有人相信明天仍然值得认真穿衣迎接。

我留下了这两件东西。

当然，我不能让它们保持原样。

Pip-Boy 从来不是为星裔干扰、重力跃迁引擎畸变、现代武器遥测系统，或定居星系种种奇怪情况而设计的。避难所制服虽然结实，却不足以应对真空、恶劣大气，或那些通常比我更早找上门的麻烦。

所以我开始改装它们。

新的密封结构。

新的内衬。

更好的野外防护。

更简洁的界面。

一副不仅能承载怀旧之情的坚固框架。

我不知道什么时候才能完成。

我心里有一部分想把它们留给自己。

另一部分却知道，它们不该永远被锁起来。

也许有一天，会有另一个人穿上它们。

一个懂得即使身处死去的世界，人们仍会寻找、仍会战斗、仍会背负希望穿越废墟的人。

那位幸存者送给我的，远不止一套衣服和一台机器。

他让我想起，有些世界会轰轰烈烈地终结。

而有些人，仍然会继续前行。

excerpt: The Cassilia's Power Fist series continues to grow with multiple faction-themed variants now available on Starfield Creations.
content:
Cassilia's Power Fist has officially expanded into a growing collection of faction-themed Power Fist releases.

What started as a single experimental close-combat project has gradually evolved into a larger framework built around Cassilia's combat legacy and the idea of bringing true Power Fist gameplay to Starfield.

Several versions are now available, including:

* UC Vanguard Power Fist
* Crimson Fleet Power Fist
* Argos Extractors Power Fist
* Starborn-themed Power Fist variants
* Additional experimental releases and future faction packs

If you browse Starfield Creations, any release beginning with CPF belongs to the same Power Fist series.

The goal of the project is simple:

Bring satisfying explosive melee combat to Starfield while creating a flexible framework that can continue to expand with new factions, new visual styles and new gameplay effects.

More Power Fist variants are already planned, and the series will continue to grow alongside the larger Cassilia Universe project.

Thank you to everyone who has downloaded, tested, endorsed and supported these releases.

If you have not tried the series yet, feel free to browse the CPF collection on Starfield Creations and find the version that best fits your character.

title: Cassilia's Power Fist Is Released
excerpt: Cassilia's Power Fist brings three standalone Power Fist variants, explosive melee progression, Combat Serum support and a reusable framework for future Starfield Power Fist mods.
content:
Cassilia's Power Fist is now released.

This project brings a fully functional Power Fist system to Starfield, built around explosive melee combat, progression mechanics and Cassilia's own combat legacy.

The release includes three standalone Power Fist variants: UC Vanguard Style, Crimson Fleet Style and Argos Extractors Style. Each version connects to a different chapter of Cassilia's past, from her Vanguard service to undercover operations and her early industrial life as a miner.

These are not simple skins. Each Power Fist is a standalone weapon that can be crafted at the Pharmaceutical Lab, and each one contains hidden details for players to discover.

The system grows stronger through combat. As players unlock ranks, the Power Fist gains new explosive chain effects, delayed detonations, particle-style impact effects and finally a Tesla-based main explosion effect.

There may also be something beyond Rank 4. Cassilia only smiled when I asked her about it.

Cassilia Combat Serum is also part of the release. For a short duration, the serum pushes the Power Fist into an overdrive state, allowing it to unleash its full destructive potential. It is powerful, but it should be used wisely.

This mod is also designed as a reusable framework for other mod authors. The ESM framework can be loaded in Creation Kit, duplicated and used as the foundation for future Power Fist-style weapons. I hope it helps the Starfield modding community build many different close-combat creations.

Cassilia's Power Fist is another step forward for the Cassilia Universe project. Future updates may bring new Power Fist models, additional custom effects, new serum types and more Cassilia-themed content.

Punch first. Ask questions later.

zh-CN.title: Cassilia 的动力拳套正式发布
zh-CN.excerpt: Cassilia 的动力拳套带来三款独立武器、爆炸近战成长机制、战斗血清支持，以及可供未来《星空》动力拳套 Mod 复用的框架。
zh-CN.content:
Cassilia 的动力拳套（Cassilia's Power Fist）正式发布了。

这个项目为《星空》加入了一套完整可用的动力拳套系统，以爆炸式近战、成长机制和 Cassilia 自身的战斗经历为核心。

本次发布包含三款独立动力拳套：UC 先锋队风格、深红舰队风格和阿戈斯采矿公司风格。每个版本都对应 Cassilia 过去的一段经历，从她在先锋队服役、参与秘密潜伏行动，到早年作为矿工的工业生活。

它们不只是简单的皮肤。每一款动力拳套都是独立武器，可以在制药工作台制作，并且都藏有一些细节等待玩家发现。

这套系统会随着战斗逐渐成长。玩家解锁更高等级后，动力拳套将获得新的连锁爆炸、延迟引爆、粒子式冲击特效，最终解锁以特斯拉能量为核心的主爆炸效果。

或许，Rank 4 之上还隐藏着什么。我问 Cassilia 时，她只是笑了笑。

Cassilia 战斗血清也包含在这次发布中。它能在短时间内让动力拳套进入超载状态，释放全部破坏力。威力很强，但请谨慎使用。

这款 Mod 同样被设计成可供其他作者复用的框架。作者可以在 Creation Kit 中加载 ESM 框架，复制并以其为基础制作未来的动力拳套类武器。我希望它能帮助《星空》Mod 社区创造出更多不同风格的近战作品。

Cassilia 的动力拳套也是 Cassilia 宇宙项目向前迈出的一步。未来的更新可能会带来新的拳套模型、更多自定义特效、新的血清类型，以及其他 Cassilia 主题内容。

Cassilia 的動力拳套（Cassilia's Power Fist）正式發佈了。

這個項目為《星空》加入了一套完整可用的動力拳套系統，以爆炸式近戰、成長機制和 Cassilia 自身的戰鬥經歷為核心。

本次發佈包含三款獨立動力拳套：UC 先鋒隊風格、深紅艦隊風格和阿戈斯採礦公司風格。每個版本都對應 Cassilia 過去的一段經歷，從她在先鋒隊服役、參與秘密潛伏行動，到早年作為礦工的工業生活。

它們不只是簡單的皮膚。每一款動力拳套都是獨立武器，可以在制藥工作台製作，並且都藏有一些細節等待玩家發現。

這套系統會隨著戰鬥逐漸成長。玩家解鎖更高等級後，動力拳套將獲得新的連鎖爆炸、延遲引爆、粒子式衝擊特效，最終解鎖以特斯拉能量為核心的主爆炸效果。

或許，Rank 4 之上還隱藏著甚麼。我問 Cassilia 時，她只是笑了笑。

Cassilia 戰鬥血清也包含在這次發佈中。它能在短時間內讓動力拳套進入超載狀態，釋放全部破壞力。威力很強，但請謹慎使用。

這款 Mod 同樣被設計成可供其他作者復用的框架。作者可以在 Creation Kit 中加載 ESM 框架，複製並以其為基礎製作未來的動力拳套類武器。我希望它能幫助《星空》Mod 社區創造出更多不同風格的近戰作品。

Cassilia 的動力拳套也是 Cassilia 宇宙項目向前邁出的一步。未來的更新可能會帶來新的拳套模型、更多自定義特效、新的血清類型，以及其他 Cassilia 主題內容。

先出拳，問題留到之後再問。

title: Cassilia Personal Log-01: About My Favorite UC Power Fist
excerpt: A recovered personal log from Cassilia's brief service with the UC Vanguard, describing the abandoned Power Fist prototype.
content:
I was not Starborn then.

I was only Cassilia.

For a short time, I wore the colors of the UC Vanguard and tried to believe that discipline, orders and polished military reports could make the Settled Systems feel safer.

That was when they chose me for the prototype.

The engineers called it a close-combat amplification platform. The soldiers called it the Power Fist.

The project was ambitious.

The results were terrifying.

The first time I saw it tested, the impact cracked the reinforced target frame and threw the operator backward across the room. Everyone cheered until he tried to stand. His arm was broken in three places.

They said it was a calibration issue.

It was not.

The weapon did exactly what it was built to do. It amplified force beyond the limits of the human body. Most test subjects could manage only a few strikes before the recoil found bone, tendon or nerve. After that, the reports became quiet. Words like unsuitable, unstable and unacceptable risk began replacing words like breakthrough.

I should have walked away.

Instead, I asked for another trial.

There was something in the rhythm of it. The weight. The delay before impact. The way the whole frame had to move with the strike, not against it. It was not a weapon you wore on your hand. It was a weapon that demanded your entire body answer for it.

The engineers watched me after the third test. Then the sixth. Then the twelfth.

No fracture.
No dislocation.
No hesitation.

After that, they stopped calling it impossible.

During one Vanguard operation, we encountered a Terrormorph before the evacuation route was clear. The official record says suppressive fire forced it back long enough for the squad to withdraw.

That is not what happened.

It came through the smoke faster than anything that large should move. I remember one of the soldiers shouting my name. I remember the prototype locking around my arm. I remember the impact more than the fear.

One strike.

The creature left the ground.

For a moment, everyone stopped firing.

Later, the UC denied the incident. I understand why. A weapon that breaks soldiers is a failed project. A weapon that only one person can use is not a weapon at all. It is a liability with a name.

So the Power Fist disappeared into storage, and the reports became myths.

Some Vanguard recruits still tell the story. Most of them think it is an exaggeration. A battlefield rumor. Another heroic lie polished by time.

Let them think that.

Some truths are safer when they sound impossible.

zh-CN.title: Cassilia 私人日志-01：关于我最喜欢的 UC 动力拳套
zh-CN.excerpt: 一份来自 Cassilia 短暂服役于 UC 先锋队时期的私人日志，讲述了那件被废弃的动力拳套原型。
zh-CN.content:
那时的我还不是星裔。

我只是 Cassilia。

有一小段时间，我穿着 UC 先锋队的制服，试着相信纪律、命令和精心修饰的军方报告能让定居星系变得更安全。

就是那时，他们选中了我来测试原型。

工程师称它为近距离战斗增幅平台。士兵们则叫它动力拳套（Power Fist）。

这个项目雄心勃勃。

结果却令人恐惧。

我第一次看到测试时，冲击力震裂了加固靶架，还把操作员掀飞到房间另一端。所有人都在欢呼，直到他试着站起来——他的手臂断了三处。

他们说这是校准问题。

并不是。

那件武器精准地完成了设计目标：将力量放大到人类身体所能承受的极限之外。大多数受试者只能挥出几拳，反冲力就会伤及骨骼、肌腱或神经。从那之后，报告渐渐沉默了。‘不适用’‘不稳定’‘不可接受的风险’开始取代‘突破性进展’等字眼。

我本该转身离开。

可我却要求再试一次。

它的节奏里有某种东西吸引着我。重量、击中前的短暂停顿，以及整个身体必须顺着拳势一起移动，而不是对抗它的方式。这不是一件只戴在手上的武器，它要求你的全身都为这一拳负责。

第三次测试后，工程师们盯着我。第六次之后也是。第十二次之后依然如此。

没有骨折。

没有脱臼。

没有犹豫。

从那以后，他们不再称它为不可能。

在一次先锋队行动中，撤离路线尚未清理完毕，我们遭遇了一只骇变兽（Terrormorph）。官方记录称，压制火力迫使它后退，为小队争取了撤离时间。

但事实并非如此。

它从烟雾中冲出来，快得不像那样庞大的生物该有的速度。我记得一名士兵在喊我的名字。我记得原型拳套锁紧在手臂上的感觉。我记得的冲击，比恐惧更清晰。

一拳。

那怪物离开了地面。

有那么一瞬间，所有人都停止了射击。

后来，联合殖民地否认了这次事件。我明白原因。一件会把士兵弄伤的武器，就是失败的项目；一件只有一个人能用的武器，根本算不上武器。它只是一个有名字的风险。

于是动力拳套被封存，报告变成了传说。

直到今天，一些先锋队新兵还在讲述那个故事。大多数人觉得那只是夸大其词，是战场传闻，是被时间打磨过的另一个英雄谎言。

就让他们这样想吧。

有些真相，听起来越不可能，反而越安全。

title: Cassilia UC Vanguard Power Fist — Prototype Phase Complete
excerpt: Development of the Cassilia UC Vanguard Power Fist has entered the prototype stage. Core design, model integration and combat effects are now functional in-game.
content:
The next project in the Cassilia Universe is officially underway.

Cassilia's UC Vanguard Power Fist has now reached the prototype phase. Originally designed during Cassilia's service with the United Colonies Vanguard, the weapon was intended to provide overwhelming close-quarters combat power against hostile wildlife and extreme threats.

Current development progress:

* Prototype visual design completed
* 3D model imported into Starfield
* First-person and third-person testing completed
* Initial combat VFX implemented
* Impact effects and energy strike visuals working in-game

According to internal UC records, the project was eventually suspended after repeated field tests resulted in severe arm injuries among standard Vanguard personnel. The force generated by the Power Fist exceeded safe operating limits for ordinary soldiers.

Cassilia, however, continued to use modified prototypes during several classified Vanguard operations.

The current goal is to deliver a weapon that feels powerful, industrial and believable within Starfield's NASA-punk universe while expanding the growing Cassilia storyline.

More updates will be shared as development progresses.

zh-CN.title: Cassilia UC 先锋队动力拳套——原型阶段完成
zh-CN.excerpt: Cassilia UC 先锋队动力拳套已进入原型阶段，核心设计、模型导入和战斗特效现已在游戏内正常运行。
zh-CN.content:
Cassilia 宇宙的下一个项目正式启动了。

Cassilia 的 UC 先锋队动力拳套现已进入原型阶段。这件武器最早设计于 Cassilia 在联合殖民地先锋队服役期间，目的是让士兵在面对敌对野生生物和极端威胁时，拥有压倒性的近距离战斗能力。

目前的开发进度：

* 原型视觉设计已完成

* 3D 模型已导入《星空》

* 第一人称与第三人称测试已完成

* 初始战斗视觉特效已实现

* 命中冲击与能量打击特效已在游戏中正常运行

根据联合殖民地内部记录，标准先锋队士兵在多次实地测试中出现严重手臂损伤后，该项目最终被暂停。动力拳套产生的力量超出了普通士兵的安全操作范围。

然而，Cassilia 仍在数次机密先锋队任务中使用经过改装的原型。

当前的目标，是让这件武器在《星空》的 NASA-punk 世界观中显得强大、工业化且可信，同时继续扩展 Cassilia 的故事。

随着开发推进，我会分享更多进展。

title: Building Personal Logs On A Preview Branch
excerpt: I started moving the portfolio workflow away from local edits and into safer preview branches.
content:
Today I started building the new Personal Logs section for the portfolio.

At first, this website was mostly a place to show my Starfield mods, screenshots and download numbers.

But after working on Cassilia, THE TERMINUS and the Cassilia Universe for a while, I realized that some things are worth recording outside of normal mod pages.

Not everything is a release note.

Sometimes it is a small idea.
Sometimes it is a development problem.
Sometimes it is a player comment that makes the whole project feel more real.

That is why I wanted Personal Logs to feel less official and more personal.

I also moved this work into a preview branch instead of editing the live site directly. After spending too much time pushing local changes and waiting for deployment, this feels like a much better workflow.

The plan is simple:

* build new website features in preview branches
* review them safely
* merge them only when they feel ready

This should make future updates faster, cleaner and less stressful.

Personal Logs is still a small feature, but I think it will become an important part of the site.

It will be a place for modding notes, Cassilia Universe fragments, website updates, and random moments from the road to becoming a better Starfield creator.

zh-CN.title: 在预览分支上构建个人日志
zh-CN.excerpt: 我开始把作品集网站的开发流程从本地直接修改，转向更安全的预览分支。
zh-CN.content:
今天，我开始为作品集网站搭建新的 Personal Logs（个人日志）栏目。

最初，这个网站主要用来展示我的《星空》Mod、截图和下载数据。

但在制作 Cassilia、THE TERMINUS 和 Cassilia 宇宙一段时间后，我意识到，有些值得记录的事情并不适合放进普通的 Mod 页面。

并不是每件事都要写成更新公告。

有时只是一个小小的创意。

有时是开发中遇到的问题。

有时是一条玩家留言，让整个项目突然变得更加真实。

这就是为什么我希望 Personal Logs 少一点官方公告的味道，多一点个人记录的感觉。

我也把这部分工作移到了预览分支，而不再直接修改线上网站。过去花了太多时间在本地推送修改、等待部署，如今这个流程让我感觉顺畅多了。

计划很简单：

* 在预览分支开发新的网站功能

* 安全地检查和确认

* 确认准备就绪后再合并上线

这样未来的网站更新应该能更快、更整洁，也更省心。

个人日志目前还是一个小功能，但我认为它会逐渐成为网站重要的一部分。

这里会记录 Mod 开发笔记、Cassilia 宇宙的故事片段、网站更新，以及我在成为更优秀《星空》创作者的路上遇到的各种日常小事。

title: A Mod Collection Included My Work
excerpt: Seeing one of my mods appear in a larger Starfield collection was a very encouraging moment.
content:
Recently another creator added one of my mods to a larger Starfield collection.

Seeing my work appear alongside established creators was a very encouraging moment.

It reminded me that every project starts small.

zh-CN.title: 我的 Mod 被收录进一个作品合集
zh-CN.excerpt: 看到自己的 Mod 出现在一个更大的《星空》作品合集中，是件很受鼓舞的事。
zh-CN.content:
最近，另一位创作者把我的一个 Mod 加入了一个更大型的《星空》作品合集。

看到自己的作品和那些经验丰富的作者的作品并列出现，我感到非常鼓舞。

这也提醒我，每一个项目都是从小小的起点开始的。

title: Who Was Cassilia Before Becoming Starborn?
excerpt: Cassilia's old uniform represents a forgotten chapter of her life before becoming Starborn.
content:
Before becoming Starborn, Cassilia was once associated with Constellation.

Her old uniform represents a forgotten chapter of her life.

Many future projects will continue exploring this part of her story and expand the Cassilia Universe.

zh-CN.title: 成为星裔之前的 Cassilia 是谁？
zh-CN.excerpt: Cassilia 的旧制服承载着她成为星裔之前、一段被遗忘的人生。
zh-CN.content:
成为星裔之前，Cassilia 曾与群星组织（Constellation）有过一段渊源。

她的旧制服代表着那段被遗忘的人生。

未来会有更多项目继续探索她的这部分经历，并逐步扩展 Cassilia 宇宙。

zh-TW.title: 成為星裔之前的 Cassilia 是誰？
zh-TW.excerpt: Cassilia 的舊制服承載著她成為星裔之前、一段被遺忘的人生。
zh-TW.content:
成為星裔之前，Cassilia 曾與群星組織（Constellation）有過一段淵源。

她的舊制服代表著那段被遺忘的人生。

未來會有更多項目繼續探索她的這部分經歷，並逐步擴展 Cassilia 宇宙。

title: Someone Finally Called It The Cassilia Universe
excerpt: A player's comment made the Cassilia Universe Project feel real for the first time.
content:
A player recently commented:

"Please keep us updated. I can't wait to see where you take the CUP."

That was the first time someone recognized the larger idea behind these mods.

It made me realize that Cassilia is no longer just a character mod.

The Cassilia Universe Project has officially begun.

zh-CN.title: 终于有人称它为“Cassilia 宇宙”
zh-CN.excerpt: 一位玩家的留言，让 Cassilia 宇宙计划第一次变得如此真实。
zh-CN.content:
最近，有位玩家留下了一条评论：

“请继续分享进展，我迫不及待想知道你会把 CUP 带向何方。”

这是第一次有人看到了这些 Mod 背后更宏大的构想。

那一刻我意识到，Cassilia 已经不再只是一个角色 Mod。

Cassilia Universe Project（Cassilia 宇宙计划）正式开始了。
